title: Tripo settings
description: Configure Tripo 3D connections and spending limits.
subtitle: Manage the 3D generation service connection and spending limits.
localOnly: Open this page in local Aura to change settings and test the connection.
regionHint: The region must match the site for your Tripo account and key.
replaceKey: Enter a new key to replace it
removeKey: Remove the saved key when saving
environmentKey: The runtime environment supplies the key. Connection settings are read-only.
budgetHint: Measured in Tripo credits. Each paid stage reserves credits before submitting a task.
invalidBudget: The current budget is invalid. Enter and save new limits to fix it.
limitedHint: Leaving group or cloud image limits empty blocks the corresponding paid requests.
unlimitedHint: Unlimited mode still records each stage. Tripo charges for actual usage.
budgetLocalOnly: Budget management is available locally only.
tripo_settings_forbidden: Tripo settings and connection checks are available locally only.
tripo_budget_invalid: Each limit must be greater than 0 and no more than 1,000,000.
tripo_budget_stale: The budget changed. Reload before saving.
tripo_budget_busy: The ledger is processing paid records. Try saving again later.
tripo_key_missing: Save a Tripo API key first.
tripo_check_failed: Connection failed. Check the region, key and network.
page_operation_failed: Tripo settings cannot be read or saved right now.
